Start with a task

Edit the text and categories to fit your work.

01

Add the text to organize

Each row receives one suggested category.

One message per line, up to 200 rows. Paste support messages, email summaries or feedback.

↑

Import your existing spreadsheet

Save Excel files as CSV first. Maximum file size: 2 MB; maximum rows per batch: 200.

02

Define your categories

Describe the task in your own words.

One category per line. Use “Name: description” to distinguish similar options.

↳

Include “Other” or “Human review” for messages that need a closer look.

03

Ready to classify

Review the text and categories, then process each row.

“Show an example” uses preset illustrations, not measured model outputs. A connected Open-Jev service is required to classify your own text.

Your input is sent to the connected Open-Jev service only when you select “Start classification”. This page does not save your content in browser storage.

04

Review and download your results

Download the completed results as a CSV.
